Once the house is decorated, you can focus on putting up diyas, which is an essential part of Diwali decorations. You can place them in strategic locations such as the entrance, windows, and around the house to create a warm and welcoming ambiance. By decorating the house first, you'll create a beautiful backdrop for your diyas and make a great impression on your relatives when they arrive. Plus, it will give you a sense of accomplishment and help you feel more prepared for the festivities ahead.
